cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10.2 FATAL_ERROR)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(helib)

# Load in extra commands (possibly generated by oraqle, but could be empty)
set(GENERATED_SOURCES)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/additional_commands.cmake)

#add_compile_options(-O1)
add_executable(main main.cpp ${GENERATED_SOURCES})

target_link_libraries(main helib)
